episodes.name: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 1
episodes.overview: LA Lakers vs. Boston Celtics  In this pre-recorded primetime show, presented in conjunction with Game 1 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel welcomes comedian Russell Brand and matches NBA Most Valuable Player LeBron James against a local busboy in the arcade game Pop-a-Shot.

episodes.name: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 2
episodes.overview: LA Lakers vs. Boston Celtics In this primetime show broadcast with Game 2 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with Ashton Kutcher. In the second round of the Pop-a-Shot challenge featuring a local busboy, the opponent is Basketball Hall of Famer Charles Barkley.

episodes.name: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 3
episodes.overview: Boston Celtics vs. LA Lakers In this primetime show broadcast with Game 3 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with Drew Barrymore, Aunt Chippy plays blackjack to try and win $80,000 for the audience, and Guillermo visits the teams on media day and discusses "Sex and the City 2" with various players.

episodes.name: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 4
episodes.overview: Boston Celtics vs. LA Lakers In this primetime show broadcast with Game 4 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with the cast of "Grown Ups". In the third round of the Pop-a-Shot challenge featuring a local busboy, the opponent is Lakers star Kobe Bryant.

episodes.name: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 5
episodes.overview: Boston Celtics vs. LA Lakers In this primetime show broadcast with Game 5 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with Jessica Alba and attempts to shatter a backboard. In the fourth round of the Pop-a-Shot challenge featuring a local busboy, the opponent is Lakers forward Lamar Odom.

episodes.name: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 6
episodes.overview: LA Lakers vs. Boston Celtics In this primetime show broadcast with Game 6 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with David Arquette, and Dr. Phil McGraw offers his perspective on LeBron James' possible departure from Cleveland. In the final round of the Pop-a-Shot challenge featuring local busboy Ricardo Reyes, the opponent is Nuggets All-Star Carmelo Anthony, with a surprise gift awaiting Ricardo if he again prevails.

episodes.name: Game Night: NBA Finals 2010, Game 7
episodes.overview: LA Lakers vs. Boston Celtics In this primetime show broadcast with Game 7 of the NBA Finals between the Lakers and Celtics, Jimmy Kimmel talks with Danny DeVito, and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar narrates the "history" of the storied rivalry.
